title: How Spool reads your folders
lede: Everyone keeps their projects their own way. Here is what Spool understood of yours, with your own examples, and the rules you can change. A change is shown before it is made, and Ctrl+Z undoes it. Nothing moves on your disk.
versions: {n} projects carry a version number in their name: versions of the same song
versionDirs: {n} projects set aside as older versions by their folder (Backup, versions, old...)
fromFolder: {n} songs are named after their folder (the folder is the song)
numbered: {n} songs named by a number alone:
words: Working words left out of names:

titleRule.label: A song's title comes
titleRule.hint: Automatic: from the folder when it holds that song alone, else from the project. You can choose one.

folder.label: A song folder holds
folder.hint: By name: each different project name is a song, its versions under it. One song: everything in a song folder makes one song (except folders holding other song folders).

multi: {n} folders hold several songs. Tick the ones that are a single song:
settingsHint: What Spool understood of the way you keep your projects, and the rules to change (titles, single-song folders).
